info.name: CATAAS Get a Random Cat Image

params.name: json
params.description: When `true`, return a JSON metadata document instead of the binary image.

params.name: html
params.description: When `true`, return an HTML page that embeds the image.

params.name: type
params.description: Sized variant of the image.

params.name: width
params.description: Resize the image to the specified width in pixels (max 1000).

params.name: height
params.description: Resize the image to the specified height in pixels (max 1000).

params.name: fit
params.description: Resize strategy when both width and height are provided.

params.name: position
params.description: Position of the cropped image when `fit=cover` or `fit=contain`.

params.name: filter
params.description: Visual filter applied to the image.

params.name: blur
params.description: Blur radius when `filter=blur`.

params.name: brightness
params.description: Brightness multiplier for `filter=custom`.

params.name: lightness
params.description: Lightness offset for `filter=custom`.

params.name: saturation
params.description: Saturation multiplier for `filter=custom`.

params.name: hue
params.description: Hue rotation in degrees for `filter=custom`.

params.name: r
params.description: Red channel multiplier (0-255) for `filter=custom`.

params.name: g
params.description: Green channel multiplier (0-255) for `filter=custom`.

params.name: b
params.description: Blue channel multiplier (0-255) for `filter=custom`.

items.docs: Returns a random cat image. By default the response is the binary image payload; pass `json=true` to receive a metadata JSON document with an `_id`, `tags`, `mimetype`, and a `url` you can embed.

info.name: CATAAS Get a Random Cat Image by Tag

params.name: tag
params.description: One tag or several comma-separated tags. Example: `cute` or `cute,orange`.

params.name: json
params.description: When `true`, return a JSON metadata document instead of the binary image.

params.name: html
params.description: When `true`, return an HTML page that embeds the image.

params.name: type
params.description: Sized variant of the image.

params.name: width
params.description: Resize the image to the specified width in pixels (max 1000).

params.name: height
params.description: Resize the image to the specified height in pixels (max 1000).

params.name: fit
params.description: Resize strategy when both width and height are provided.

params.name: position
params.description: Position of the cropped image when `fit=cover` or `fit=contain`.

params.name: filter
params.description: Visual filter applied to the image.

params.name: blur
params.description: Blur radius when `filter=blur`.

items.docs: Returns a random cat image that carries the provided tag (or any of the comma-separated tags supplied). Supports the same sizing, filter, and JSON/HTML response negotiation as `/cat`.

info.name: CATAAS Get a Random Cat GIF

params.name: json
params.description: When `true`, return a JSON metadata document instead of the binary image.

params.name: html
params.description: When `true`, return an HTML page that embeds the image.

params.name: width
params.description: Resize the image to the specified width in pixels (max 1000).

params.name: height
params.description: Resize the image to the specified height in pixels (max 1000).

items.docs: Returns a random animated cat (image/gif). Same query parameters as `/cat` may be used for sizing and JSON negotiation. Filters do not apply to GIFs.

info.name: CATAAS Get a Random Cat Image with Text Overlay

params.name: text
params.description: Text to overlay onto the image.

params.name: fontSize
params.description: Font size in pixels for `/says/` text overlays.

params.name: fontColor
params.description: Font color name or hex value (e.g., `red`, `#ffffff`).

params.name: fontBackground
params.description: Background color behind the overlay text.

params.name: json
params.description: When `true`, return a JSON metadata document instead of the binary image.

params.name: html
params.description: When `true`, return an HTML page that embeds the image.

params.name: type
params.description: Sized variant of the image.

params.name: filter
params.description: Visual filter applied to the image.

items.docs: Returns a random cat image with the supplied text rendered on top. Use `fontSize`, `fontColor`, and `fontBackground` to style the overlay. URL-encode any special characters in `text`.

info.name: CATAAS Get a Random Tagged Cat with Text Overlay

params.name: tag
params.description: One or more comma-separated tags.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to overlay onto the image.

params.name: fontSize
params.description: Font size in pixels for `/says/` text overlays.

params.name: fontColor
params.description: Font color name or hex value (e.g., `red`, `#ffffff`).

params.name: fontBackground
params.description: Background color behind the overlay text.

params.name: json
params.description: When `true`, return a JSON metadata document instead of the binary image.

items.docs: Returns a random cat image that carries `tag` and renders `text` on top. Combines the behavior of `/cat/{tag}` and `/cat/says/{text}`.

info.name: CATAAS Get a Specific Cat Image by Id

params.name: id
params.description: Catalog id of the cat document.

params.name: json
params.description: When `true`, return a JSON metadata document instead of the binary image.

params.name: html
params.description: When `true`, return an HTML page that embeds the image.

params.name: type
params.description: Sized variant of the image.

params.name: filter
params.description: Visual filter applied to the image.

items.docs: Returns the cat image identified by `id`. The id is the MongoDB document id surfaced in catalog (`/api/cats`) responses.

info.name: CATAAS Get a Specific Cat with Text Overlay

params.name: id
params.description: Catalog id of the cat document.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to overlay onto the image.

params.name: fontSize
params.description: Font size in pixels for `/says/` text overlays.

params.name: fontColor
params.description: Font color name or hex value (e.g., `red`, `#ffffff`).

params.name: fontBackground
params.description: Background color behind the overlay text.

items.docs: Returns the cat image identified by `id` with `text` rendered on top.
